weapon.d: Effective against flying foes. Grants Spd+3. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+X (X = 25% of unit's level; max 10), deals damage = 20% of unit's Spd (including when dealing damage with a Special triggered before combat), and neutralizes unit's penalties during combat.

special.d: Boosts damage by 30% of damage dealt to unit.
Boosts damage by 50% of damage dealt to unit.

b.d:
At start of turn, if any foe's HP ≤ unit's HP-5 and that foe is adjacent to another foe, inflicts 【Panic】on that foe.
【Panic】
Converts bonuses on unit into penalties through its next action.

c.d: At start of turn, inflicts Spd-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Spd/Def-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Spd/Def-4 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
